audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows Skill on rows 0, 4 and 5 while content win[] and the packet chart say Ahri; twelve fields also misgender Ahri as he/him.
audit.why: Ahri's Q pierces the wave at level 1, and Spirit Rush plus first-item burst own the 6-to-one-item window; content layer and packet agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; Charm's role as a channel-cancel on Chaos Storm and Ahri Q's true damage (resistances-invalidated) were unstated; two Do's/Don'ts bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed.
audit.why: Charm is 12s flat, Viktor W 17s rank 1, R 120s. Charm instantly stops movement abilities and cancels Viktor's R channel per missingInteractions. Ahri Q return is true damage, so MR stacking is a poor answer. Gravity Field is a zone, not a movement ability, so Charm does not remove a placed field.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; bleed bullets replaced with Gravity Field vs Spirit Rush landing and Charm-into-true-damage kill threat.

audit.why: Kit: 12s at every rank — the trade window after a miss is concrete.
